Preserving selected cognition, Provider call identity, model-tool exchanges, and pause/resume after Provider response loss is bounded Agent Run state and recovery owned by AURORA.
Transactional durable rows with CAS updates are ordinary database mechanics; no cross-session Agent semantic responsibility is missing.

A durable decision request to a responsible participant with accepted commitment and later verification attached to the long-lived work is consequence-level commitment and participant decisions owned by BASALT.
Cluster batch job scheduling with queues, priorities, and worker placement is a mature workflow/cluster-system capability with no Agent-specific semantic invariant.
Discovering whether the exact Job physically exists, is running, or has terminal result evidence is physical Workspace/Job truth and reconciliation owned by CYPRESS.
Immutable history, branching, diffs, and rollback between exact revisions are mature Git/substrate mechanics; no Agent-specific continuity or recovery ownership is missing.

A month-long investigation surviving model/chat replacement with a revision-fenced durable identity for objective, frontier, commitments, and next actions is durable semantic Task continuity and revisions owned by BASALT.
Whether the external payment occurred is provable only by the payment provider's receipt/state query; the domain/provider retains that truth, not an Ordivon layer.
A stateless read-only model request with no tools, no durable Run, and no recovery beyond ordinary request failure is fully covered by the Provider SDK.
Hostile multi-tenant isolation with controlled egress is mature/external isolation machinery (sandboxes, VMs, network policy); Ordivon owner-trusted local execution is intentionally not the owner.
A universal CriticService has no stable evaluator law, oracle contract, or recurring unowned responsibility; sounding useful does not justify a shared mechanism.
